name: Steamed Yellow Wax Beans (Tips Trimmed, Cooked Soft)
whyItWorks: Tender stringless yellow wax beans trimmed and steamed until soft and flexible. Mild flavor and lower in harsh fibrous cellulose than older green snap beans.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trim tips from beans, steam in a basket over boiling water for 12–14 minutes until tender and limber. Toss with olive oil and fine salt.
